No, the conviction should not be reversed on causation. Under the Kibbe line of cases, a defendant whose conduct hastens a death is a legal cause of it even when the victim was terminally ill, because the defendant's act was a but-for and substantial cause of the earlier death. Whether the president had the malice murder requires is a separate question, and his knowing shipment of a known sub-strength cancer drug to dependent patients likely supplies it.

CONFIDENCE: 72
